decision.rationale:
I followed docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-23-decision-guide.md. Correctness comes first, then the copydeck rules, then persona taste. The prompt named no spec file for the verdict table, so I give it here and edited no files.

# | source | issue | verdict | reason
1 | sari-27 | l05 SSR/SSG linked to the tailwind-css term | Accept | Factual error. No SSR glossary term exists, so I used rBold plus an inline explanation.
2 | sari-27 | JSX never defined before l02-r1 | Accept | The Pro rule says jargon is explained the first time it appears.
3 | dimas-14 | l04-q3 prompt gives the answer away | Accept | Neutral prompt plus a lazy gallery image as a distractor. The answer is still line 2.
4 | dimas-14 | l02-q3 prompt gives the answer away | Accept | The prompt now describes the symptom. The hint already covers setSuka.
5 | sari-27 | l05-q2 prompt gives the answer away | Accept | Neutral prompt. No extra line needed.
6 | naya-8 | l01-r2 tests components that Junior never saw | Accept | I took the option of adding a short "balok susun" line to the Junior framework card. No new concept card, so C32 is safe.
7 | wulan-38 | l01-q6 is abstract and its hint uses an analogy Junior never saw | Adapt | Kept in Junior and reworded with the bicycle analogy, so Junior does not lose a question.
8 | sari-27 | "build" never defined | Accept | Defined where it first appears in l02.
9 | sari-27 | staging/production and API not taught before anc-p5 | Accept | Explanations added to the l07 Pro card.
10 | naya-8 | anc-j5 answer length and repetitive explanation | Adapt | Choice lengths are already similar (7/7/4 words) and the "satu pemain" framing is needed for the limit question type. Only explainCorrect changes, so it now says why.
11 | naya-8 | l01 story/concept use hard words (alur, rumah perumahan) | Accept | Everyday words. "rumah perumahan" is replaced with "rumah jadi" throughout, Pro included.
12 | raka-11 | anc-j1 answer repeats the prompt's analogy | Accept | Analogy removed from the Junior prompt. Answer reworded ("punya aturan").
13 | naya-8 | l07 Junior step list and debugging card too heavy | Adapt | Kept seven steps to match the title and visual. Split into sentences of 12 words or fewer, used simpler words and dropped "Console" from Junior.
14 | naya-8 | anc-j4 distractor "Inspect" is not taught in Junior | Accept | Replaced with Commit, which Junior learns in l06. The id stays.
15 | raka-11 | l07-r1 answer repeats the prompt | Adapt | Vercel and Netlify are never taught in Junior, so I used action-based choices of similar length.
16 | sari-27 | l07-q5 "menaruh di Chrome" | Accept | Meaning error. Changed to "mengetes".
17 | dimas-14 | git init described as a daily command; conflict wording | Accept | Factual accuracy.
18 | sari-27 | l03-q5 explainWrong does not say why | Accept | The guide requires explanations to say why.
19 | wulan-38 | grammar ("Tetapi" after a full stop, "benda", redundancy) | Accept | Standard Indonesian. The TF answer is still false.
20 | dimas-14 | l07-q3 mislabelled as analogy | Accept | Removed the type so it becomes a plain mcq. No analogy field needed.

Counts: 15 accepted, 5 adapted, 0 rejected, 0 deferred. There are 7 major issues, and every one is covered by these instructions. All edits are in one owned file, src/content/worlds/a11-menara-alat/index.ts, so this is a single batch. done: true once the executor applies the edits and the validator passes.

judgeIssues.where: a11-l05 concept 'Kecepatan, SSR/SSG, dan audit Lighthouse'
judgeIssues.problem: Meaning error: rTerm('tailwind-css', 'SSR atau SSG') links the text 'SSR atau SSG' to the Tailwind glossary entry. Tapping it explains Tailwind, not rendering.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Use rBold('SSR atau SSG'), or link it to a render glossary term if one exists. Do not use tailwind-css.

judgeIssues.problem: The review asks 'Apa fungsi JSX di komponen React?', but the concept card only says 'React (buatan Meta) memakai JSX' and never says what JSX is. The answer cannot be worked out from the lesson.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add to the l02 concept: 'JSX, yaitu cara menulis tampilan mirip HTML langsung di dalam JavaScript'.

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway: the prompt 'Ketuk baris untuk foto utama di paling atas halaman yang memperlambat LCP' points straight at the only line. No debugging is needed.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Neutral prompt: 'Ketuk baris yang membuat LCP lambat dan layar bisa meloncat.' Add a second lower down (e.g. a gallery image that also has loading="lazy" plus width/height) as a distractor.

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway: 'Ketuk baris yang salah karena tidak memakai setSuka untuk memperbarui state' states the bug. Only one line changes suka.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Prompt: 'Tombol tidak bertambah saat diklik. Ketuk baris penyebabnya.' Move the setSuka hint into hints.

judgeIssues.problem: Giveaway: the prompt 'melanggar praktik SEO untuk judul halaman' names the <title> line, which is the only title line.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Ketuk baris yang membuat halaman ini sulit dibedakan di hasil pencarian.' Optionally add a second plausible line, such as an empty og:title.

judgeIssues.problem: Junior TF 'Framework membantu memecah tampilan menjadi bagian kecil yang dipakai ulang.' with hint 'Ingat balok susun yang dipakai berulang.' Components and 'balok susun' appear only in the Pro-only concept card. Naya has never seen this idea.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Make r2 Pro-only, or add a short junior line to the framework card: 'Framework memecah halaman jadi keping kecil, seperti balok susun.'

judgeIssues.problem: 'Kalau kamu paham satu framework, framework lain lebih mudah dipelajari.' is abstract for an 8-year-old who knows no frameworks. The hint 'Ingat denah perumahan yang mirip-mirip' refers to an analogy no junior card taught. The answer can only be guessed.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Make it Pro-only, or reword the junior text: 'Kalau kamu sudah bisa naik satu sepeda, sepeda lain jadi lebih mudah.' with a matching hint.

judgeIssues.where: a11-l02 concept 'Empat pilihan', a11-l03 CSR/SSR/SSG concept, a11-anc-p2
judgeIssues.problem: 'build' ('penerjemah kode saat build', 'sekali saat build') is used as if known. It is never defined. A beginner on her commute cannot tell SSG from SSR without knowing what build means.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Define it once, where it first appears in l02: 'build (tahap mengemas kode sebelum tayang)'.

judgeIssues.problem: The anchor asks 'Apa beda lingkungan Staging dan Production', but the lessons only say 'uji lintas browser di staging' and 'latihan di ruang ganti (staging)'. Production appears only in the l07-q2 match. 'integrasi API' is also left unexplained.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Add one sentence to the l07 Pro concept: 'Staging adalah server uji coba yang mirip aslinya; production adalah situs yang dipakai pengunjung.' Gloss API briefly.

judgeIssues.problem: The right answer 'Banyak teman bekerja bersamaan, lalu hasilnya digabung' is the longest choice, and the prompt's phrase 'game satu pemain' gives it away. The explainCorrect line 'Game satu pemain hanya punya satu pemain.' says the same thing twice and does not explain WHY.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Make the choices about the same length (e.g. 'Kerja bareng teman lalu digabung'). explainCorrect: 'Di Git, kamu dan teman bisa menyimpan di jalur masing-masing, lalu menyatukannya.'

judgeIssues.where: a11-l01 story + concept 'Library: kamu yang mengatur'
judgeIssues.problem: 'rumah gambaranmu sendiri', 'rumah perumahan' and 'alurnya kamu atur sendiri' are hard for a beginning reader. 'Alur' is abstract, and 'rumah perumahan' is a redundant phrase. The story has three sentences of comparison before the question.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Junior: 'Library seperti memilih meja dan kursi sendiri. Framework seperti rumah yang sudah jadi, lengkap dengan aturannya.' Avoid 'alur'.

judgeIssues.problem: The right answer 'Library kamu atur sendiri, framework sudah beraturan' repeats the analogy in the prompt. 'beraturan' is vague. Raka can pick it without understanding.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Remove the analogy from the prompt, or reword the right answer to 'Library kamu pilih sendiri, framework sudah punya aturan'. Give the distractors comparable length.

judgeIssues.where: a11-l07 junior concept 'Tujuh langkah' + 'Jangan panik saat ada error'
judgeIssues.problem: A list of seven steps, 'riset, sketsa, desain, serah terima, koding, uji, lalu tayang', with non-standard or difficult words ('riset', 'serah terima', 'koding'). The debugging card has 3 sentences with 'Console, bagian alat periksa di browser'. That is too much load for a beginning reader.
judgeIssues.suggestion: For junior, cut to 4-5 simple steps (cari ide, gambar sketsa, buat, coba, pasang). Drop 'Console' from junior, or put it in a separate short sentence.

judgeIssues.problem: The distractor 'Inspect' is never taught in junior; it only appears in the companion talkPrompt. Naya meets an unknown English word in the anchor quiz.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Replace it with a term junior has learned, such as 'Commit' (explainWrong: 'Commit hanya menyimpan titik simpan, belum memasang web.').

judgeIssues.problem: The right answer 'Tempat penayangan web di internet' repeats the prompt ('supaya semua orang bisa membukanya'), and 'penayangan' is formal. The other choices ('Alat menggambar desain', 'Alat pencatat titik simpan') are obviously wrong.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Use concrete names in junior too: 'Vercel / Netlify' vs 'Figma' vs 'Git', each with one short hint.

judgeIssues.problem: Meaning error: 'Nadia menaruh website Toko Rani di Chrome laptopnya'. A website is not 'put' in Chrome; it is opened or tested there.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Nadia mengetes website Toko Rani di Chrome laptopnya dan tampil rapi.'

judgeIssues.problem: 'Alur kerja harian Git hanya butuh empat perintah. git init ...' is inaccurate: git init runs once per project, not daily. The Pro card's 'conflict yang harus kamu pilih sendiri' is awkward and does not explain what to do (resolve).
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Empat perintah dasar: git init (sekali di awal), git add, git commit, git push.' Conflict: 'conflict yang harus kamu selesaikan dengan memilih baris mana yang dipakai.'

judgeIssues.problem: 'Bootstrap bukan komponen React dengan Tailwind.' is awkward and does not explain WHY Bootstrap does not fit (it is not React components, and its CSS clashes with Tailwind).
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Bootstrap memakai CSS-nya sendiri dan bukan komponen React, jadi tidak menyatu dengan proyek Tailwind Raka.'

judgeIssues.problem: Indonesian grammar: 'Pemula boleh memakai framework. Tetapi dasarnya perlu dipelajari dulu.' starts a sentence with a conjunction after a full stop. Calling software a 'benda' in 'Git dan GitHub adalah benda yang sama' is imprecise. In Pro, ', tidak ada bedanya' is redundant.
judgeIssues.suggestion: 'Pemula boleh memakai framework, tetapi dasarnya perlu dipelajari dulu.' Change 'benda' to 'alat'. Drop 'tidak ada bedanya'.

judgeIssues.problem: Labelled type 'analogy', but the question is a plain recall question about the DevTools tab, with no analogy. This mislabels the question category and may break the analogy-related UI and stats.
judgeIssues.suggestion: Change it to type 'scenario' with a short story (e.g. 'Tombol Beli tidak bereaksi...'), or drop the type.
